description: 微信开发者工具：帮助开发者简单高效地开发和调试微信小程序与公众号网页 | Weixin DevTools - develop and debug WeChat Mini Programs and Official Account web pages efficiently
notes_cn: 免管理员版本：直接解包官方 NSIS 安装器（官方安装器内嵌 requireAdministrator，必须提权才能运行），因此不会注册文件关联（.wxml/.wxss/.wxproj/.mgepackage）与卸载信息
应用内的「检查更新」会调用官方安装器（需要管理员），请改用 scoop update 更新
登录态与项目缓存保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\微信开发者工具（已链接持久化），卸载不会丢失
命令行入口：wechat-devtools（即官方 cli.bat，支持 open/login/preview 等子命令）
notes: No-admin build: the official NSIS installer is unpacked instead of executed (it embeds requireAdministrator), so file associations (.wxml/.wxss/.wxproj/.mgepackage) and uninstall entries are not registered
The in-app 'check for updates' runs the official installer and needs administrator rights; use scoop update instead
Login state and project caches live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\微信开发者工具 (linked to a persisted directory) and survive uninstallation
CLI entry point: wechat-devtools (the official cli.bat; supports subcommands such as open/login/preview)
pre_install: $appDir = Join-Path $dir 'app'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appDir '卸载微信开发者工具.exe.nsis') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appDir '$PLUGINSDIR') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
